GROBTEA.NS.d: The Grob Tea Company Limited cultivates, manufactures, and sells tea in India. The company owns five tea gardens under the names of Doyang, Dessoie, Kanu, and Teen Ali tea estates located in the belt of Assam; and Pathemara tea estate in the Cachar district of Assam. Its gardens comprise an area of 4236.07 hectares and 2332.71 hectares of tea plantation. The company was incorporated in 1895 and is based in Kolkata, India.

GUJRAFFIA.NS.d: Gujarat Raffia Industries Limited manufactures and sells polyethylene tarpaulins, high density polyethylene (HDPE)/polypropylene (PP) woven sacks, and fabrics in India. It also offers PE tarpaulins, plastic and ground sheetings, geomembranes, tents, shelters, pond and canal linings, fumigation covers, HDPE and PP woven bags, azolla beds, grow bags, weed mats, vermibed and ropes, etc. The company also exports its products worldwide.

HARRMALAYA.NS.d: Harrisons Malayalam Limited primarily engages in the plantation and selling of tea, rubber, and pineapples in India and internationally. It operates through three segments: Tea, Rubber, and Others. The company offers CTC and orthodox, custom blended, and organic teas; and rubber products, including latex, smoked sheets, crepes, and crumb/block rubber products. It also produces cardamom, malabar pepper, cloves, nutmeg, cocoa, vanilla, arecanut, coconut, and banana, as well as coffee.

HOMESFY.NS.d: Homesfy Realty Ltd. is an Indian real estate brokerage and advisory company primarily focused on the residential sector. The company provides end-to-end real estate services, including property search, advisory, and transaction facilitation, for retail buyers and real estate developers. It assists developers in selling new constructed properties and aids potential customers in purchasing them.

HRHNEXT.NS.d: HRH Next Services Ltd. operates as a business process outsourcing (BPO) and business process management (BPM) provider, specializing in multi-channel customer engagement and support services. The company offers a comprehensive suite of solutions including inbound and outbound voice support, chat, email, and social media management.

IGPL.NS.d: I G Petrochemicals Limited manufactures and sells organic chemicals in India and internationally. It offers phthalic anhydride that is used in the production of plasticizers, unsaturated polyester resins, alkyd resins, paints, CPC pigments, plastic currency, paper boards, leisure boats, and sail of windmills.

INDIACEM.NS.d: The India Cements Limited produces and sells cement and cement related products in India and internationally. It offers cement and allied products under the Sankar Super Power, Coromandel King, and Raasi Gold brands, as well as the Coromandel White and Coromandel Super brands; and ready mix concrete. The company also engages in the generation of power from windmills and thermal power plants; provision of ship hiring services; and ownership and operation of coal mines.

INDUSTOWER.NS.d: Indus Towers Limited provides telecom tower infrastructure sharing services. The company acquires, builds, deploys, owns, operates, and manages telecom towers and communication structures for various mobile operators. As of March 31, 2020, it owned and operated 42,053 towers with 75,715 co-locations in 11 telecommunications circles in India. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Gurugram, India. Indus Towers Limited is a subsidiary of Bharti Airtel Limited.

IVP.NS.d: IVP Limited manufactures and sells foundry chemicals in India. The company offers resins/binders, foundry coatings, and other allied products used in various fields, such as foundry, composites, insulation, and refractory, as well as ferrous and non-ferrous foundries. It also provides polyurethane systems for use in the manufacture of shoe soles, including unit soles, safety shoes, and chappals; and composite, insulation, and refractory resins. In addition, the company exports its products.

JALAN-SM.NS.d: JALAN TRANSOLUTION is an Indian logistics and transportation company. They provide transportation services for goods and materials across different locations. The company is based in India.

JAMNAAUTO.NS.d: Jamna Auto Industries Limited manufactures and sells tapered leafs and parabolic springs under the JAI brand in India and internationally. It offers tapered multileaf springs that are used in commercial and special application vehicles. The company also provides rear air suspensions used in city and intercity buses; steerable/non steerable lift axles; and bogie suspensions that are used in on-off highway applications. Jamna Auto Industries Limited was founded in 1954 and is based in New Delhi, India.

JBMA.NS.d: JBM Auto Limited manufactures and sells auto components, tools, and buses in India and internationally. It operates through three segments: Sheet Metal Components, Assemblies & Sub-assemblies; Tool, Dies & Moulds; and OEM Division.

JIYAECO.NS.d: Jiya Eco-Products Limited manufactures bio fuels in India. It offers bio-mass pallets and bio-mass briquettes from the wastages, including agro, forestry, and solid waste. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

KKCL.NS.d: Kewal Kiran Clothing Limited engages in manufacturing, marketing, and retailing branded readymade garments and finished accessories for men and women in Asia, in the Middle East, and the Commonwealth of Independent States. It offers casual, formal, semi-formal, and western wear for men, as well as fusion wear for women; jeans, trousers, shirts, T-shirts, jackets, pullovers, and fashion accessories; and branded accessories, such as deodorants, watches, wallets, belts, and inner wear.

KOLTEPATIL.NS.d: Kolte-Patil Developers Limited operates as a real estate company in India. It constructs and develops residential projects, commercial and retail projects, IT parks, and integrated townships; rents immovable properties; and provides project management services for managing and developing real estate projects. The company markets its projects under the Kolte-Patil and 24K brands. Kolte-Patil Developers Limited was founded in 1991 and is based in Pune, India.

LYKALABS.NS.d: Lyka Labs Limited engages in manufacturing pharmaceutical formulations and active pharmaceutical ingredients various therapeutic segments in India. It manufactures and sells various formulations, including emollient, topical steroid, antifungal agent, topical anti-bacterial, acne management, dermatological formulation, pain killer, anti-aging, cleansing lotion, hair care, anti-dandruff shampoo, sunscreen, anti-acne, cosmeceutical, anti-oxidant, proton pump inhibitor, anti-malarial, anti-bacterial, corticosteroid…

MANINDS.NS.d: Man Industries (India) Limited manufactures, processes, and trades in submerged arc welded pipes and steel products in India. The company offers longitudinal submerged arc welded line pipes for use in oil, gas, petrochemicals, fertilizers, and dredging sectors; and helically submerged arc welded line pipes for use in oil transportation, water supply, sewerage, agriculture, and construction, as well as for high pressure applications.

MANOMAY.NS.d: Manomay Tex India Ltd. is a textile company that makes and distributes ready-to-stitch fabrics, handling yarn winding and weaving before dispatching finished goods. Kailashchandra Hiralal Laddh founded it in 1978, and it is based in Bhilwara, India.

MANUGRAPH.NS.d: Manugraph India Limited manufactures and sells printing machines in India. It offers newspaper Web offset, folder, and packaging converting machines. The company also exports its products to Germany, France, the United Kingdom, the United States, and internationally. Manugraph India Limited was founded in 1972 and is based in Mumbai, India.

PARAGON.NS.d: Paragon Fine & Speciality Chemical Ltd. engages in the business of custom synthesis and manufacturing of speciality chemical intermediates involving complex and differentiated chemistry. The company was founded by Pravinchandra Jasmat Vasolia, Kishorkumar Panchabhai Patolia, Vallabh Ratanji Savaliya on February 2, 2003, and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.

PIDILITIND-BL.NS.d: PIDILITE INDUSTRIE is an Indian adhesive and construction chemical company. It manufactures and markets a wide range of products including adhesives, sealants, construction chemicals, and art materials. Pidilite's popular brands include Fevicol, Fevikwik, and Dr. Fixit.

PRADIP.NS.d: Pradip Overseas Limited manufactures and exports home textiles, home decors, and home furnishings in India and internationally. It offers cushions, towels, comforters, flannels, jerseys, readymade garments, and seersuckers; and home furnishing products, such as table linens, bed spreads, quilts, cushion covers, and curtains, as well as cotton and micro products. The company was founded in 1980 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

RELCHEMQ.NS.d: Reliance Chemotex Industries Limited, established in 1977 and headquartered in Kolkata, produces and distributes synthetic and blended yarns worldwide for home furnishing, industrial and apparel uses. It exports to about 37 countries.

RHETAN.NS.d: Rhetan TMT Ltd., established in 1984 and based in Ahmedabad, produces and distributes thermo-mechanically treated (TMT) bars in India. The bars go into homes, bridges, elevated roads, tall buildings and other civil engineering projects.

RIR.NS.d: Ruttonsha International Rectifier Ltd. is an Indian company manufacturing and marketing power semiconductors and rectifiers. The company's products are used in power control and conversion applications. Ruttonsha International Rectifier Ltd. is based in India.

RPGLIFE.NS.d: RPG Life Sciences Limited, an integrated pharmaceutical company, develops, manufactures, and markets branded formulations, generic, and synthetic active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) in India and internationally. It operates through Domestic Formulations, International Formulations, and Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients segments. The company offers synthetic APIs in various therapeutic categories, including immunosuppressants, anti-psychotic, anti-anginal, anthelmentics, anti-convulsant, anti-spasmodic, etc.

SAHYADRI.NS.d: Sahyadri Industries Ltd. makes and sells fibre cement corrugated sheets and non-fibre cement flat sheets. It has Building Material and Power Generation segments, the first covering roofing sheets, accessories, doors and other building products, and the second producing electricity from windmills. L.B. Patel founded it in 1947, and it is headquartered in Pune, India.

SEKURITIND.NS.d: Saint Gobain Sekurit India Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker SEKURITIND and traded in INR. Its country is India.

SHK.NS.d: S H Kelkar and Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and supplies fragrances, flavors, and aroma ingredients in India. Its fragrances are used in personal care, hair care, skin care and cosmetic, fabric care, and household products, as well as in fine fragrances; and flavors are used in dairy, beverage, confectionery, bakery, pharmaceutical, and savory products.

SIS.NS.d: SIS Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in rendering security and related services company in India, Australia, Singapore, and New Zealand. The company operates through three business groups: Security Services (India), Security Services (International), and Facility Management.

STUDDS.NS.d: Studds Accessories Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker STUDDS and traded in INR. Its country is India.

TECHIN.NS.d: Techindia Nirman Limited focuses in the real estate and infrastructure development businesses in India. The company was formerly known as Nath Seeds Limited. Techindia Nirman Limited was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Mumbai, India.

UDAYJEW.NS.d: Uday Jewellery Industries Limited is an Indian company involved in the jewellery business. Their specific business model, products, and services are not readily available.

VIPULLTD.NS.d: Vipul Limited engages in real estate development and services business in India. Its project portfolio includes residential, commercial, and retail projects, as well as integrated townships and lifestyle gated communities. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Gurugram, India.

VIRINCHI.NS.d: Virinchi Limited is an information technology company founded in 1990 and based in Hyderabad, India, serving customers worldwide. It reports software development and services, IT-enabled services and healthcare segments. Its products include QFund for short-term lending, vCard, a UPI-based credit card, and V23, a healthcare practice management and patient engagement platform.

YAARII.NS.d: Yaarii Digital Integrated Services Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the provision of management and maintenance, and equipment renting services in India. The company operates through four segments: Management and Maintenance Services; Equipment Hiring Services; LED Lighting; and Financing and Related Activities.

ZYDUSWELL.NS.d: Zydus Wellness Limited develops, produces, markets, and distributes health and wellness products in India. The company provides sugar substitute products under the Sugar Free Gold, Sugar Free Natura, and Sugar Free Green brands. It also offers a range of specialty skincare products, such as face washes, facial masks, scrubs, sun blocks, winter care body lotions and creams, cleansers and toners, and soaps under the Everyuth Naturals brand name; and men skincare products under the brand name of EverYuth Menz.
